items.name: theme
items.title: YODY theme
items.description: Canonical theme (shadcn shape): semantic role tokens aliased onto the YODY palette + tokenized type scale. Source of raw values: colors_and_type.css (:root + 4 surface adapters). Roles mapped to utilities via @theme inline in tailwind/globals.css.

items.name: components
items.title: YODY components
items.description: The universal component layer (@apply + tokens): buttons, typography, forms, overlays, identity, data-viz, state. No-Preflight bundle to inline under the no-build CDN; build mode uses tailwind/yody.tailwind.css as the entry.
items.docs: Component classes: .btn (+7 variants ×3 sizes) · .field/.input/.select/.checkbox/.radio/.toggle · .modal/.drawer/.toast/.tip/.popover · .avatar/.badge/.chip/.tag · KPI/sparkline/progress/charts · skeleton/empty/error/banner · .type-* utilities. Sizes resolve from [data-surface].

items.name: kit-app
items.title: App Kit
items.description: Composite back-office/PLM blocks: app shell · top-bar · side-rail · tabs · data-table · filter-bar · command palette · chart engine. Token-driven, Tailwind-enabled.

items.name: kit-ai
items.title: AI Kit
items.description: AI vocabulary v2 (Restrained default · add .dir-b for Expressive): composer · suggestion chip · halo field · confidence meter/gauge · generation/stream · suggestion review · output panel · disclosure · animated ✦ sparkle iconography. Marks AI vs human work (iris + glow). Ships v1 classes + a compat layer that upgrades them to the v2 look.

items.name: kit-collab
items.title: Collab Kit
items.description: Multiplayer layer: comment thread · mention · annotation pin · approval card/stack · activity feed · version row · presence cursor · role badges.

items.name: kit-fashion
items.title: Fashion Kit (scoped)
items.description: Fashion-domain blocks: color/material swatch · pantone chip · season tag · size matrix · measurement diagram · BOM table · style card · lookbook tile · tech-pack A4. Domain-scoped, not universal.
